talking_points.text: Michigan issuers reported $195.5M sold across 18 Form D filings this week, up 342% vs. the prior 4-week average. The largest was Net Alliance Fund One LLC (Grand Rapids, Commercial) targeting $40M. Good question to ask: are founders in real estate favoring equity rounds over venture debt right now?
Fencecrete Holdings, LLC disclosed a deal. It was one of 4 M&A filings this week. Use it to ask how buyers are valuing Michigan other assets and whether consolidation is accelerating.

14 Michigan-based pooled funds filed Form Ds, reporting $192.7M raised so far — led by English Capital Partners LP (Hedge Fund). A natural opener: what are LPs asking Michigan sponsors for in today's fundraising market?
